item.title: Cytokinetics Aficamten (MyQorzo) nHCM Trial
item.description:
• Summary: Cytokinetics announced positive results from the ACACIA Phase 3 trial of aficamten (brand name MyQorzo) in patients with non‑obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (nHCM). The drug met the primary endpoint, succeeding where Bristol Myers Squibb's mavacamten failed. Aficamten is a cardiac myosin inhibitor designed to reduce hypercontractility and improve symptoms, and these data support a regulatory filing for nHCM.
  • MoAs: Cardiac myosin inhibitor (reduces actin‑myosin cross‑bridge formation)
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive, Endpoints News, STAT News

item.title: Intercept FXR Agonist Phase 2 Failure
item.description:
• Summary: Intercept Pharmaceuticals' next-generation FXR agonist fails Phase 2 trial for NASH, marking another setback for the company.
  • MoAs: Farnesoid X receptor (FXR) agonist - regulates bile acid synthesis and lipid metabolism.
  • Sources: Endpoints News
